title: NONPOWER-QUARTER-CAP: terminal cap strengthens the fourth-root classical envelope

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N),the SINGLE NONPOWER-QUARTER-CAP algorithm of proof.md/qudit_decoder.md/robust_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Mainn>=2^48 uses exact m=ceil(n^(1/4)), exact nonpower intermediate lengths lambda_i=min(base+i,H),M_i=(1-2^(i-m-2))2^lambda_i,Dwidth=floor(sqrt(128m))-1,Hlin=base+m-1,H=Hlin-Dwidth, base=ceil(n/(m+1)-m/2)+66, final full2^d root, measured leafrange, explicit rank/division/inverseinterval merge and proved conditional bucket moments/freshtrial renewal, bmax=floor(H/2)-1024u, per-block r=b+ceilLog(n^5), ONE explicit wide-top coarse batch, sequential signed odd/twoadic vectors and ONE global A=4Lblk fine-attempt cap. All source rejections, failed/missing/capped attempts, incorrect histories, bit operations, actual lookups, addresses, source/extraction, table/circuit generation, explicit finiteprecision Clifford+T synthesis, initialization,gates,measurements,resets and ALL acquired/discarded/padded1024-copy microbanks count. ALLFOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch,with separately proved finite exhaustive correctness and uniform absolute resource constants. F(n)=n^(3/4)-n^(1/2)+(3/2)n^(1/4) is the common leading expression; the complete classical object also has the explicit negative cap term. Resource envelopes usepositive n2 values atn1. Total charged work O(n^(9/4)2^F), exact index3/4. Actual constant64 leaf augmentation pays exact terminal triangular loss<=64m; all supported lengths, windows, blocks and fields use capped widths. The growing plateau is charged asO(n2^H); minimum-width loss preconditions are rechecked. No cube verdict substitutes for this joint fourth-root derivation.
